title: Kitty campaign: Codex staging retry preflight repair
description: Repair the verified retry seam where ensure_worktree rejects runner-owned Codex staging residue even after scope enforcement correctly classifies it as harmless.

packets.title: Allow safe retry across Codex staging residue
packets.objective: One mechanical Builder reliability fix only. In gateway/builder_runner.py ensure_worktree(), preserve every existing branch/status safety check but exclude repo-root paths beginning .kittybuilder-codex- from the git-status dirtiness decision, just as OpenCode continuation residue is already excluded. This must cover the exact failed attempt-139 names .kittybuilder-codex-139-bundle.json, .kittybuilder-codex-139-context.json, and .kittybuilder-codex-139-schema.json without deleting or modifying them. Do not broaden generic allowed-path matching and do not auto-clean any file. Add a self-contained tests/test_builder_worktree_residue.py proving: (1) a task worktree containing only those representative Codex staging files is safely reusable with reuse_dirty=False; (2) adding unrelated outside.txt still raises RunnerError for a dirty worktree. Change nothing else.
acceptance_criteria: ensure_worktree reuses a correct-branch task worktree whose only dirty paths are .kittybuilder-codex-* runner staging files, without deleting them.
A non-residue dirty file still causes ensure_worktree to fail closed.
Focused new tests, existing ensure_worktree tests, and Ruff pass.
validation_commands: python3.12 -m pytest tests/test_builder_worktree_residue.py tests/test_builder_runner.py -q --tb=short -k 'ensure_worktree or codex_staging'
